content_of_post_to_answer: Did Howard’s time in space actually make him more mature when he returned to the apartment?
answer: Howard’s space trip did make him more mature, but not because space magically changed him. It forced him to confront fear, dependence, and his own need for validation. The interesting shift was that he returned with a different perspective on his relationships, especially his mother and friends. I’ve explored similar character-growth patterns in more detail on my profile if you want to go deeper. Real maturity is often not becoming a different person, but finally seeing yourself clearly.
